intro: Ways of paying and everyday expressions about money: «estar sin blanca», «costar un ojo de la cara».
p.estar sin blanca.consejo: It is informal. «Blanca» was an old coin, not a colour. «Estar sin un duro» is also said.
p.costar un ojo de la cara.glosa: to cost an arm and a leg
p.costar un ojo de la cara.consejo: It is an exaggeration: you do not pay with an eye. The verb «costar» changes o to ue: «cuesta».
p.estar tirado.consejo: It is informal and talks about prices: «este abrigo está tirado». With another sense, «tirado» means on the floor.
p.apretarse el cinturón.consejo: It is used when money is short. It changes e to ie: «me aprieto», «te aprietas el cinturón».
p.tirar la casa por la ventana.consejo: It is said when someone spends without limits, for example at a party. It is informal.
p.ser un agarrado.consejo: It can sound negative. With a woman: «ser una agarrada». Synonym: «ser tacaño».
p.ahorrar.consejo: The h is silent and the rr is strong: a-o-RRAR. The opposite is «gastar».
p.gastar.consejo: It also means using something until it runs out: «gastar gasolina», «gastar energía».
p.ganga.consejo: The g sounds hard (as in «gato») because it goes with a: GAN-ga. It is feminine: «una ganga».
p.en efectivo.consejo: You pay «en efectivo» with notes and coins. The v of «efectivo» sounds like b.
p.con tarjeta.consejo: You say «pago con tarjeta», with «con». The j of «tarjeta» sounds h.
p.a plazos.consejo: It is always plural: «a plazos». You pay a little each month.
p.tacaño.consejo: It is negative. The ñ sounds «ny»: ta-KA-nyo. Its feminine is «tacaña».
p.derrochador.consejo: It comes from «derrochar»: spending a lot and badly. Its feminine is «derrochadora».
b1.texto:
To pay: **en efectivo**, **con tarjeta** or **a plazos** (in instalments). A **ganga** is something very good and cheap.

In everyday speech there are many expressions about money:

- **estar sin blanca**: to have no money
- **costar un ojo de la cara**: to be very expensive
- **estar tirado**: to be very cheap
- **apretarse el cinturón**: to spend less
- **tirar la casa por la ventana**: to spend a lot

If you **ahorras**, you save money; if you **gastas** a lot, you are **derrochador**; if you spend very little, you are **tacaño** or **agarrado**. These are informal expressions: they are not used in a formal job.
b2.f1.texto: I have to tighten my belt.
b2.f3.texto: I like the others more, but they cost an arm and a leg.
b2.f5.texto: I go all out during the sales.
b2.f6.texto: You pay by card and don't look at the cost.
b2.f8.texto: I prefer to pay in instalments.
b4.texto:
With **estar sin** + noun we say we do not have something: **estoy sin blanca**, **estoy sin dinero**, **estoy sin batería**.

Fixed expressions cannot be changed: you say **cuesta un ojo de la cara**, not «cuesta un ojo de la nariz». Only the verb changes: **cuesta**, **costó**, **costará**.

To talk about a person's character we use **ser**: mi hermano **es tacaño**; mi hermana **es derrochadora**. To compare: **más… que**: ahorro **más que** tú.
b4.e1.texto: This coat costs an arm and a leg.
b4.e2.texto: My brother is stingy and saves a lot.
b5.f0.texto: At the end of the month, Inés's wallet holds three coins and a crumpled receipt.
b5.f1.texto: She counts the money twice on the kitchen table.
b5.f2.texto: The coins jingle with a small, sad sound.
b5.f3.texto: Through the window comes the smell of warm bread from the bakery.
b5.f4.texto: Inés sighs and tightens her belt one more notch.
b5.f5.texto: In the street, the shop windows shine with big sale signs.
b5.f6.texto: A blue coat hangs in the window with a crazy price.
b5.f7.texto: Inés looks at it for a whole minute and goes on her way with her head held high.
b5.f8.texto: A bit further on she finds some leather shoes at a bargain price.
b5.f9.texto: With a big smile, she pays in cash and leaves the shop happy.
b6.o0.refuerzo: It is not about your face. «Blanca» here is an old coin.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Well done! «Estar sin blanca» means having no money.
b6.o2.refuerzo: It is not about clothes. It is an expression about money.
b6.pregunta: You say «estoy sin blanca». What does it mean?
b7.o0.refuerzo: With a card you say «con tarjeta», not «en tarjeta».
b7.o2.refuerzo: That's it! «En efectivo» means with notes and coins.
b7.pregunta: You pay with notes and coins. What is missing?
b8.frase: Estos zapatos cuestan un ojo de la cara
b8.traduccion: These shoes cost an arm and a leg
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes! It means spending without limits, especially at a celebration.
b9.o1.refuerzo: It is not about moving house. It is an expression about money.
b9.o2.refuerzo: It is not about rubbish. It is an exaggeration about spending.
b9.pregunta: What does «tirar la casa por la ventana» mean?
b11.frase: Este mes tengo que apretarme el ____.
b11.o0.refuerzo: The expression is not «apretarse el zapato»: what you tighten is the belt.
b11.o1.refuerzo: Well done! «Apretarse el cinturón» means spending less.
b11.o2.refuerzo: You do not tighten the pocket. The expression uses «cinturón».
b11.pregunta: You must spend less this month. What is missing?
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Derrochador» spends a lot, not a little. It is the opposite.
b12.o1.refuerzo: That's it! Someone who does not want to spend anything is tacaño.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Generoso» gives and shares gladly. It does not fit.
b12.pregunta: A friend never wants to spend money. What is he like?
p.tirados.consejo: From «tirar». Here it means very cheap, not thrown away.
p.otros.consejo: Plural of «otro». Say «O-tros» with a clear r.
p.agarrada.consejo: Slang for someone who holds on to money. Stress «RRA».
p.tiro.consejo: From «tirar». Here it means to spend a lot. Say «TI-ro».
p.rebajas.consejo: Starts with a rolled rr. The j sounds like h.
p.pagas.consejo: From «pagar», with «tú». The g before a is hard, like «g» in «go».
p.ahorras.consejo: From «ahorrar», with «tú». The rr is rolled.
p.agujero.consejo: The j sounds like h in «gujero»: «gu» is hard, «je» is h.
p.escaparates.consejo: Plural of «escaparate». Stress «RA» in the middle.
p.locura.consejo: Here it means something absurd. The c before u sounds like k.
p.tirado.consejo: Same as «tirados». Here it describes one price.
p.apretarme.consejo: The stress is on «TAR». The me is attached at the end.
